note: The hand route key, fixed before any model run (30 Oct 2026). One entry per rule id across the eight packs in faultline/packs (79 distinct ids, 110 rule files; the racing ids repeat across oval, road-gt and open-wheel with identical text). route is what video judges: window (a fixed-camera clip window), scan (a contact scan over a broadcast recording), out (nothing in the closed vocabulary measures it). A window or scan rule names its fields; every number in a predicate carries the span of rule text it came from, or the site key that sets it. An out rule names, in words, the fact video would need. Thresholds (from): no number sits in a predicate; each threshold is a `line` (or `within`, `min`) of {site, span}: the site.json key that holds the value and the rule words it came from. provenance by content. Every span is the rule's own words, case kept; a threshold span names its quantity (the number as written or the word its site key stands for); a number is a {value, span} of its own; a boolean site setting is a switch from site.json, never a threshold. A span given as a list is one alternative per copy of the rule text; the compiled row carries the one verbatim in the text compiled. the three thresholds whose value no rule's words hold (hivis_rule_share, rear_cone_half_angle_deg, structure_strip_m) are explicit site values, {site, explicit} with no span; the checker counts and lists them. (rulings 2 and 6): the moving line (moving_mps), the 0.30 m strip and the 70% share leave every rule text; they are declared in assets/site_values.json, and the checker lists a declared key as an explicit site value and counts an undeclared one (the rear cone) weak.

overhead_clearance.why: a strike overhead; the structure strip is drawn on the floor, not overhead

no_passing_at_blind_spots.why: an overtake at a marked blind spot; no second-truck or blind-spot field exists

watch_travel_path.why: where the operator is looking; no gaze field exists

avoid_loose_objects.why: debris on the truck's path; no debris field exists

no_horseplay.why: intent to show off; no field measures intent

limbs_inside_truck.why: an arm or leg outside the truck frame; the operator is set aside, not measured

yield_to_emergency_vehicles.why: an emergency vehicle with lights on; no such field exists

no_one_under_forks.why: raised forks over a person; no fork-height field exists

no_riders.why: a person riding on the truck; people on the truck are set aside as operators, not measured

trailer_secured.why: chocks or a trailer restraint; no trailer field exists

railcar_secured.why: a rail car moving during loading; no rail car field exists

pre_shift_check.why: the start of a shift and a fault a check would catch; no shift or condition field exists

overhead_guard.why: whether the overhead guard is fitted; no guard field exists

truck_lighting.why: scene light level and the truck's own lights; no light field exists

no_unapproved_changes.why: added weight or home-made parts on the truck; no truck-modification field exists

exhaust_sparks_or_overheating.why: sparks, smoke or steam from the truck; no such field exists

refuel_engine_off.why: fuelling while the engine runs; no fuelling or engine field exists

fuel_spill_cleared.why: pooled fuel or a missing cap; no spill field exists

no_fuel_leak.why: fuel dripping from the truck; no leak field exists

no_open_flame_checks.why: a flame near a tank or battery; no flame field exists

battery_change_position.why: a battery change and the parking brake; no battery field exists

battery_handling_equipment.why: a battery lifted by hand; no battery or hoist field exists

charging_area_no_flames.why: smoking or flame near charging batteries; no flame or charging-area field exists

battery_top_clear.why: metal resting on an open battery; no battery field exists

electrolyte_mixing.why: the order acid and water are poured; no pouring field exists

conduct_zero_tolerance.why: harassment, chat, social media and liveries; conduct off the track, not contact
